timer_plan.notes: No timer or edge-timing function blocks are required for this alarm handling FB.

priorities: Safety/configuration priority 1: diagnose loLevel >= hiLevel first; set error=TRUE and status=16#8001; suppress alarm updates; preserve hiAlarm and loAlarm.
Safety/configuration priority 2: if range is valid, diagnose hystWindow >= real32(hiLevel - loLevel); set error=TRUE and status=16#8002; suppress alarm updates; preserve hiAlarm and loAlarm.
Safety/configuration priority 3: on valid configuration, clear error=FALSE and status=0 before applying normal alarm hysteresis logic.
Operational priority 1: high alarm sets when Value > hiLevel using strict comparison.
Operational priority 2: high alarm clears when Value < real32(hiLevel - hystWindow) using strict comparison.
Operational priority 3: high alarm retains previous state inside the inclusive hysteresis band real32(hiLevel - hystWindow) <= Value <= hiLevel.
Operational priority 4: low alarm sets when Value < loLevel using strict comparison.
Operational priority 5: low alarm clears when Value > real32(loLevel + hystWindow) using strict comparison.
Operational priority 6: low alarm retains previous state inside the inclusive hysteresis band loLevel <= Value <= real32(loLevel + hystWindow).
Numeric priority: compute thresholds with IEEE-754 binary32 REAL arithmetic for real32(hiLevel - hystWindow), real32(loLevel + hystWindow), and real32(hiLevel - loLevel).
Output priority: assign all outputs once per scan from the final selected state and internal alarm state values.

scan_execution_order.name: edge_sampling
scan_execution_order.description: Sample all inputs once at scan start. Capture previous observed outputs for hysteresis: previousHiAlarm := hiAlarm from the prior scan and previousLoAlarm := loAlarm from the prior scan. Do not use later scan-time values for this scan.

scan_execution_order.name: safety_reset_priority_and_state_transitions
scan_execution_order.description: Evaluate configuration safety in priority order: first loLevel >= hiLevel -> ERROR_BAD_RANGE with error=TRUE and status=16#8001; else hystWindow >= real32(hiLevel - loLevel) -> ERROR_BAD_WINDOW with error=TRUE and status=16#8002; else valid -> RUN_VALID with error=FALSE and status=0. In ERROR_BAD_RANGE and ERROR_BAD_WINDOW, skip all alarm hysteresis updates so hiAlarmState and loAlarmState remain unchanged. In RUN_VALID, apply strict trigger/release comparisons and inclusive retention bands to update hiAlarmState and loAlarmState.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional_timer_fb_calls_outside_case_if
scan_execution_order.description: No timer function blocks are required. For this FB there are no top-level timer FB calls. Future timer FBs, if added, must be called unconditionally outside CASE/IF constructs.

scan_execution_order.name: unified_output_assignments
scan_execution_order.description: Assign declared outputs exactly once from final scan state: hiAlarm := hiAlarmState; loAlarm := loAlarmState; error := selected error value; status := selected status code. Invalid-configuration scans preserve the previous alarm output states while updating error/status; valid-configuration scans output the newly computed hysteresis alarm states.

formal_assertions.formula: G((loLevel >= hiLevel) -> (error & status = 16#8001 & hiAlarm = Y(hiAlarm) & loAlarm = Y(loAlarm)))
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow >= real32(hiLevel - loLevel))) -> (error & status = 16#8002 & hiAlarm = Y(hiAlarm) & loAlarm = Y(loAlarm)))
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (Value > hiLevel)) -> hiAlarm)
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (Value < real32(hiLevel - hystWindow))) -> !hiAlarm)
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (real32(hiLevel - hystWindow) <= Value) & (Value <= hiLevel)) -> (hiAlarm = Y(hiAlarm)))
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (Value < loLevel)) -> loAlarm)
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (Value > real32(loLevel + hystWindow))) -> !loAlarm)
G(((loLevel < hiLevel) & (hystWindow < real32(hiLevel - loLevel)) & (hystWindow >= 0.0) & (loLevel <= Value) & (Value <= real32(loLevel + hystWindow))) -> (loAlarm = Y(loAlarm)))
